formatted_text: To bring traffic to a **stop**.
To allow traffic **turning left**, to do so (if it can be done **without interfering with cross traffic**) **without stopping**.
To bring traffic from **all three directions** to a **stop**.
To bring traffic from **all four directions** to a **stop**.
These are two different signs, which are **mounted back to back**. It indicates whether you **may proceed or must stop**.
To indicate that you must **yield to other traffic**.
To compel you to **give priority to pedestrians** crossing the road or wanting to cross the road.
To warn you that there is a **traffic circle ahead** where they must expect to **yield**.
To indicate that **no traffic may proceed** past the sign on the road, carriageway or lane.
To indicate that there is a **one-way carriageway** to the **left, right, or ahead**.

To **give priority to pedestrians** but limit other traffic to:
(i) **emergency vehicles**,
(ii) **vehicles loading and off loading goods**, and
(iii) **maintenance vehicles**.
To indicate that there is a **single carriageway ahead** for use by vehicles from **both directions**.
To regulate the **minimum speed** of traffic.
To **compel drivers of certain heavy vehicles** to use the road or part of the road indicated by this road traffic sign.
To indicate that you must drive to the **left or right of an obstruction** where the sign is displayed.
To indicate the **direction** in which you must proceed.
To indicate to drivers the **direction in which they must turn** at the intersection ahead.
To indicate that the road or part of the road may be used by **pedestrians only**.
To indicate that the road or part of the road may be used by **cyclists only**.

To indicate that a road or part of a road may be used by **cyclists and/or pedestrians only**. To indicate to cyclists and pedestrians **which part of a road they must use**. Signs R113 and TR115 indicate that part of the road is divided and that part may be used by **cyclists and pedestrians only**. A certain part may be used by cyclists or by pedestrians only, as indicated by the road traffic sign.
Indicate that a road or part of a road may be used by **motorcyclists only**. Motorcyclists must **follow the route indicated** by the road traffic sign.
Indicate that a road or part of a road may be used by **motorcars only**.
To indicate that the road or portion of the road is set aside for **use by taxis**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by minibuses**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by midibuses**, and that the driver of a midibus **shall only use such road** or portion of such road.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by buses**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by delivery vehicles only**.
Indicates that the road or portion of the road is set aside for **use by goods vehicles**.

Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for use by **goods vehicles** with a **gross vehicle mass (GVM)** or a **gross combination mass (GCM)** exceeding the mass indicated in tonnes by means of a number on such sign.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by construction vehicles**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for use by **vehicles conveying dangerous goods**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by abnormal vehicles**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by rickshaws**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by tour buses**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by agricultural vehicles**.
Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for **use by animal-drawn vehicles**.
To give you a last opportunity to **follow an alternative route**, or to proceed on the route and **pay toll fees**.
To indicate that you must **switch on your headlights** in order to see and be seen.
Indicates that the road or portion of the road is set aside for **use by buses and minibuses**.
Indicates that the road or portion of the road is set aside for **use by buses and midibuses**.
Indicates that the road or portion of the road is set aside for **use by buses, midibuses and minibuses**.
To indicate that you must move in a **clockwise direction** at the junction.
Inform you of the **speed limit applicable** on this road. The restriction **applies from the sign**.
To **prevent certain heavy vehicles** from using a road or part of a road.
To **prohibit certain heavy vehicles** from using the road.
To warn you against a **height restriction ahead**.
To **prohibit long vehicles** from using a road where such a vehicle will not be able to negotiate a curve or will turn in such a manner that it will **disrupt or endanger other traffic**.
To **prohibit noise**.
To **prohibit pedestrians and stationary vehicles**.
To **prohibit drivers without special authorisation** from entering a certain road or section of a road.
